Game Overview

In Liquid Sort, the core idea is straightforward: dive into the vibrant world of Liquid Sort, where the thrill of solving puzzles meets colorful liquid challenges. Strategically pour and separate hues in a quest to clear jars. With each level more mind-bending than the last, this game promises endless hours of addictive logic-based fun.
